PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient seen and examined at bedside. Data:

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 60-year-old male, length of stay 2 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: COPD exacerbation. Hypertension. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient seen and examined at bedside.
